info.title: API Case
info.description: JSON:API-flavored authentication API for two independent guards: `user` (public self-registration, email verification required) and `admin` (pre-provisioned, deactivatable accounts). All responses are served with the `application/vnd.api+json` content type. Tokens are Laravel Sanctum personal access tokens, scoped to a single ability (`user` or `admin`); a token issued for one guard is rejected (403) on routes belonging to the other guard.

post.description: Creates a `user` account and dispatches a signed email-verification link. No bearer token is issued at this step: the account cannot log in until the address is verified via `GET /email/verify/{id}/{hash}`.

name.description: Required. The display name for the new account. Max 255 characters.

email.description: Required. Must be a syntactically valid email, at most 255 characters, and unique among existing users.

password.description: Required. Must satisfy the application's default password policy (see `Illuminate\Validation\Rules\Password::defaults()`) and match `passwordConfirmation`.

meta.message: Registered successfully. Please check your email to verify your account.

422.description: Validation failed: a required field is missing, malformed, the email is already taken, or the passwords do not match.

post.description: Authenticates a `user` account by email and password and, if the address is verified, issues a Sanctum token scoped to the `user` ability. Rate-limited to 6 requests per minute per client IP; exceeding it returns 429.

email.description: Required. The account's registered email address.

200.description: Credentials valid, email verified: token issued.

403.description: Credentials are valid but the account's email address has not been verified yet.

errors.title: Forbidden
errors.detail: Your email address is not verified.

422.description: Validation failed, or the email/password combination does not match any record. The same generic message is used for both a nonexistent email and a wrong password, to avoid leaking which one was incorrect.

errors.title: Unprocessable Entity
errors.detail: These credentials do not match our records.

post.summary: Log out and revoke the current token
post.description: Deletes the Sanctum access token used to authenticate this request, immediately invalidating it. Requires a valid `user` bearer token.

get.description: Consumes the signed link sent by the registration (or resend) email. The route itself is protected by Laravel's `signed` middleware, which rejects any request whose URL signature is missing, invalid, or expired (this shows up as a generic 403 before the controller ever runs); the controller then independently re-checks that `hash` equals `sha1(email)` for the given user as defense in depth. Verifying an already-verified address is idempotent and still returns 200.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The numeric primary key of the user to verify.

parameters.name: hash
parameters.description: SHA-1 hash of the user's email address, as embedded in the verification link.

parameters.name: expires
parameters.description: Unix timestamp after which the signed URL is no longer valid. Part of Laravel's URL signing, validated by the `signed` route middleware.

parameters.name: signature
parameters.description: HMAC signature over the full URL and query string, validated by the `signed` route middleware.

200.description: Email verified (or was already verified; response is idempotent).

403.description: The URL signature is missing, invalid, or expired, or the `hash` path segment does not match `sha1(email)` for the given user.

404.description: No user exists with the given `id`.

post.description: Re-sends the signed verification link to the authenticated user's email address; a no-op returning 200 if the address is already verified. Requires a valid `user` bearer token. Rate-limited to 6 requests per minute per authenticated user (falling back to IP if unauthenticated, though authentication is required to reach the handler at all).

200.description: Verification email sent, or the address was already verified (idempotent no-op).

get.description: Returns the `users` resource for the account owning the bearer token. Requires a `user`-scoped token; an `admin` token is rejected with 403.

post.description: Authenticates an `admin` account by email and password. Unlike the user guard, email verification is not required, but the account must have `isActive = true`; inactive or soft-deleted admins fail with the same generic credentials error as a wrong password, to avoid revealing account state. Issues a Sanctum token scoped to the `admin` ability. Rate-limited to 6 requests per minute per client IP.

email.description: Required. The admin account's registered email address.

password.description: Required. The admin account's plain-text password.

200.description: Credentials valid and account active: token issued.

422.description: Validation failed, or the email/password combination does not match an active record (covers wrong password, unknown email, inactive account, and soft-deleted account alike).

errors.title: Unprocessable Entity
errors.detail: These credentials do not match our records.

Translatable fields (`description`, `metaTitle`, `metaDescription`) are JSON-encoded strings (e.g. `{"en":"Shop the latest phones."}`) so they round-trip through the import endpoint. post.description: Bulk creates/updates `product-categories` resources from an uploaded `.xlsx` or `.csv` spreadsheet using the same column layout as the export endpoint. Rows are matched to existing categories by `slug`: a matching slug updates that category, otherwise a new category is created. Invalid rows are skipped and reported back instead of failing the whole import; a row's `description`, `metaTitle` and `metaDescription` cells must be JSON-encoded objects mapping locale code to string (e.g. `{"en":"Shop the latest phones."}`). Requires an `admin`-scoped token.

200.description: Import completed. Individual row failures are reported in `meta.errors` rather than failing the whole request.

422.description: Validation failed: no file was uploaded, or the file is not a `.xlsx`/`.csv` file, or exceeds 10 MB.

post.description: Creates an `orders` resource from a list of `{productId, quantity}` lines. Validates each `productId` exists and is active, then within a single database transaction locks the referenced products, verifies sufficient stock for every line, decrements stock immediately, and snapshots `sku`/`title`/`unitPrice` onto each `order-items` row. The order is created `pending` with `expiresAt` 30 minutes out, holding the stock reservation until checkout completes or the reaper reclaims it. Requires a `user`-scoped token.

productId.description: Must reference an existing, active product.

422.description: Validation failed (missing/invalid fields, a `productId` that does not exist or is inactive), or one or more lines requested more units than are in stock (`code: insufficient_stock`, `detail` lists the offending SKUs).

post.summary: Start Stripe Checkout for an order
post.description: Creates a Stripe Checkout Session (`mode: payment`) for a `pending`, non-expired order — one Stripe line item per `order-items` row — and stores the session id on the order. Returns the hosted Checkout URL for the client to redirect the browser to. The webhook, not this response, is the source of truth for payment state. Only the order's owner may start checkout. Requires a `user`-scoped token.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: The order's numeric primary key.

403.description: The bearer token does not belong to the `user` guard, or belongs to a `user` other than the order's owner.

404.description: No order exists with the given id.

409.description: The order is not `pending`, or its stock hold (`expiresAt`) has already passed.

errors.title: Conflict
errors.detail: Order is not open for checkout.

post.description: Endpoint Stripe calls with account webhook events. Authenticated by the `Stripe-Signature` header (verified against `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET`), not Sanctum. The event id is recorded before any processing, and a unique-constraint conflict on it is treated as an already-handled Stripe retry (idempotent no-op, still `200`). Handles `checkout.session.completed` (mark order paid, record payment), `checkout.session.expired` (expire order, restock items), `payment_intent.payment_failed` (record a failed payment) and `charge.refunded` (mark payment and order refunded, no auto-restock). Any other event type is accepted and ignored, so Stripe adding new event types never causes a `400`.

parameters.name: Stripe-Signature
parameters.description: Stripe's webhook signature header, e.g. `t=1690000000,v1=...`.

schema.description: A raw Stripe Event object, verbatim as sent by Stripe.

200.description: Event durably recorded (and processed, unless it was a replay or an unrecognized event type).

400.description: The `Stripe-Signature` header is missing, malformed, or does not match the payload for the configured webhook secret.

Setting `status` to `cancelled` also stamps `cancelledAt` if not already set. This action never restocks items; if goods are returned, adjust `stockQuantity` separately. Requires an `admin`-scoped token.
